conviction_note: Near-null: the event is confirmed for 15:30 JST (window 10-09 close to 10-13 close, 10-12 being Sports Day). No 月次 exist, so the quarter is not pre-visible. The weak 進捗率 is computable from the Q1 短信, which the stock answered with +1.8% the next session. The company's record is to hold a plan through the year rather than cut it mid-year (FY26 missed OP plan 465 by 10% with no revision), and interim returns were pre-announced in May. What is left is three small negatives: a tough August comp, the expanded 優待 provision booked at the Aug-31 record and a moving-strike warrant seller that caps any pop. Against them is one small positive, a short-heavy margin book. Hence findings sum -0.25 and p_up 48 on abs 2.2, giving -0.09. The two measurements agree in sign and are both near zero.
bar: Company FY2027/02 plan: sales 13,300m, OP 450m, ordinary 370m, NP 320m (unchanged at Q1, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710591349.pdf). IFIS consensus ordinary profit 370m = company plan, '会社予想並み' (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportTop?bcode=3063). No H1 forecast is published, so there is no first-half bar. The -3.0 is my read that H1 OP (Q1 104m plus a seasonally weak Q2 of roughly 70-90m) tracks behind a straight-line share of the plan. That is an inference, not a sourced bar, so every size here is capped small.
positioning_check: Baseline: JPX register 0.0% as of 2026-09-29 and margin_ratio 0.21. Correction: karauri.net (which aggregates the JPX filings) shows 大和証券 with a disclosed short of 0.79% (99,800 shares) as of 2026-09-16, up from 0.52% on 09-01 (https://karauri.net/3063/). The baseline's zero is therefore likely a truncation artefact of reading one day's file, and the position is probably a 一般信用 supply hedge around the Aug-31 優待 record date rather than informed selling. 信用倍率 is 0.21 on kabutan, 2026-10-09 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3063). The margin short side is about 5x the long side, and it was 0.66 on 07-31 per irbank (https://irbank.net/3063/margin). There is no skew in this market. Days to cover on 99.8k shares at ~22k shares a day is about 4.5 days.

findings.finding: The 6th moving-strike warrant (SBI証券) is being exercised almost every session at 93% of the prior close: 64,800 shares in September and 27,000 in late August, leaving 658,200 shares. A further 750,000 (7th, 東海東京証券) sit under a company-issued exercise suspension that the company can lift at will. So a post-print rally meets a mechanical seller worth about 15% of daily volume.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The issue was announced 2026-08-07 after the close, and the stock was flat (0.0%) on 57.5k shares the next session (Yahoo daily bars). Since exercise began on 08-25 the stock has drifted from about 1,150 to 1,108.
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang is in the level already. What is not in the level is the asymmetry it gives the reaction: exercise rises when the price rises, so upside on a good print is sold into while downside is not cushioned. If it were fully reflected you would expect upside reactions on this name to be no smaller than downside ones, and there is no record either way since the warrant is two months old.
findings.independence: Same scheme as https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260807/140120260807514967.pdf (one document family, counted once). On what the money buys: ¥800m retires the A and B preferred shares at 5% and 4% coupons (about ¥35m a year of dividends), ¥400m funds stores and ¥602m is held for M&A. So this is not distress funding, which is why the size is small.

findings.finding: Q2 (Jun-Aug) is the seasonal trough, roughly 68-69m OP in each of the last two years, and it laps a strong August 2025 (sales 108.6%, customers 105.2%). H1 OP will therefore likely land near 170-195m against a 450m full-year plan, a 進捗率 of roughly 40% versus 62-65% at H1 in FY25 and FY26. Those prior years were inflated by the May 2025 property sale (jG金山, ジェイチル名駅).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 (released 2026-07-10 at 15:30) showed OP -48.8% YoY and 23% progress, flagged by IFIS as below consensus. The stock rose 1.8% the next session (7/13) and made its year high of 1,274-1,291 within days. Last year's Q2 print (2025-10-10) was followed by about -1.4% (baseline estimate).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly it is priced. The Q1 progress rate and the property-sale base effect have been public since July, and the stock looked through them (+1.8%). The only unseen part is the July-August restaurant trend, because j-Group publishes no 月次. If the market had sold the weak progress, Q1 would have fallen rather than risen.
findings.independence: The August 2025 comp comes from last year's Q2 deck, https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/30630/140120251010571805.pdf. The quarterly OP history comes from https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3063.

findings.finding: The shareholder perks were expanded from the Aug-31-2026 record (tickets at 300-1,000+ shares rose from 4,000-12,000 yen to 7,000-25,000 yen per half), and a 30th-anniversary 1,000-yen ticket was added for every holder. The company carries a 株主優待引当金, so a larger provision is likely booked at the Q2 end, a Q2 SG&A cost on a thin ~70-90m quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior instance of a 優待 expansion hitting a print for this name. The expansion itself drove a stop-high on 2026-05-29 (+18.3%).
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody covers the name (IFIS consensus = company plan), so the cost of the perk has not been put into a quarterly number by anyone. The holders bought the perk, not its cost. The amount is an inference: the FY26 provision moved only -12.5m over a whole year, so this is a small item.
findings.independence: The 30周年 commemorative perk is in https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260528/140120260528552735.pdf. The existence of the provision is in the FY26 短信 cash-flow line, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260410/140120260410501759.pdf.

findings.finding: Positioning is short-heavy where the baseline reads it as empty. 信用倍率 is 0.21 (margin shorts about 5x longs, against 0.66 on 07-31), and Daiwa holds a disclosed 0.79% short (99,800 shares, 2026-09-16) that the baseline's register read as zero. That gives buy-back fuel if the print is merely acceptable.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved history for this name. In the US run, squeezes needed far larger short interest (18-23% of float), so this is small fuel.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly in the baseline lean already (margin_overhang +0.34). The disclosed Daiwa short is not in it, because the baseline register read 0. Much of the short side is probably 優待-related hedging that does not need to cover on news, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: kabutan 信用倍率 0.21, https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3063, a different source from karauri.

outside_window.finding: The first use of the warrant proceeds is to buy back the B preferred shares (¥500m, 4% coupon) and then the A preferred shares (¥300m, 5%, held by the chairman's asset company). Together that removes about ¥35m a year of preferred dividends. Only about ¥98m has been raised so far, so the timing is undated (2026-08 to 2029-08); it could be announced at any point, but nothing dates it inside this window.

Three properties are held for eventual sale (EXIT NISHIKI, ジュール則武, the HQ building), with a book value of ¥4,190m against ¥2,164m of attached debt. The FY27 plan of 13,300 sales and 450 OP likely needs one of these sales in H2 to be met. No sale is dated.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely. The company held its FY26 plan all year and missed OP by 10% rather than cutting mid-year, and it revises upward only when well ahead (FY24 three times, starting at Q2 2023-10-10). Returns: interim 3 yen (incl. a 1 yen commemorative) and the perk expansion were both announced 2026-05-28, so nothing new is expected; a preferred-share buyback could be added but is undated. New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: about 40% at H1 against 62-65% in FY25/FY26, but those years carried property-sale profits and the gap was visible after Q1.

baseline_tension: Mostly in agreement with the baseline. The run-up is -3.2% over 20 days and the lean is +0.5, while my findings are a faint net negative of three small items against one small positive. The strongest positive this release could carry is a held plan, plus perhaps a first preferred-share buyback, landing on a short-heavy margin book (信用倍率 0.21). I looked for both; neither can be dated into the window. The holders already looked through a far worse-looking Q1 (+1.8%). So the price probably holds everything I found, and the call is close to zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative on a 進捗率 computable from the last 短信): the H1 progress / Q2 comp finding shrank from -0.3 to -0.1. The weak progress has been public since the Q1 短信, and the company does not cut mid-year, so the release is unlikely to add a forecast cut.

Rule 1 / core table (a financing item, and a level the price already holds): the warrant-overhang finding shrank from -0.3 to -0.2, after confirming the money retires 4-5% preferred shares rather than funding distress.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension (held plan, a possible preferred-share buyback, short-heavy margin, a holder base that bought a weak Q1). I had looked for it, so p_up moved only from 46 to 48 for the rule-1 visible-progress point. abs_move_pct is left at 2.2.
The perk-provision finding moved from -0.15 to -0.1 as an inference resting on an unsized provision. The positioning finding is unchanged at +0.15.
